Browser-rendered photographic reproduction of the white-border [[Much Anger In Him (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The source collector page credits the photo, collection and description to Duncan Jenkins.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border photograph: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11144 The Star Wars Collectors Archive]; photo, collection and description by Duncan Jenkins (photograph GA08145.JPG).

== Preparation ==
The actual public collector page was rendered in a browser. Its complete rendered DOM and separate 1920 × 993-pixel page screenshot are retained independently. The displayed physical-card photograph was extracted from that screenshot at rectangle (424, 248)–(930, 929), with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. No rotation was applied. The extracted rectangle was downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 350 × 471 pixels and saved as PNG. This is a browser-rendered photographic reproduction, not the native JPEG master, a publisher image or a facsimile. Printed text, artwork, icons, legal text and paper corners were not repainted or reconstructed. The browser capture or photograph date does not establish the card’s first publication date.
